arms.label: ollama-mtp
arms.note: Ollama with the official MTP tag. This matches the vendor's Ollama arm (drafter that ships with the tag). Greedy, no penalties, thinking off.

arms.label: ollama-plain
arms.note: Ollama without a drafter, the plain Q4_K_M tag. It shows what the MTP drafter adds. Greedy, no penalties, thinking off.

arms.label: magnitude-default
arms.note: Magnitude with its catalog Qwen3.5 4B Q4 and its default DFlash drafter. This is the vendor's Magnitude arm.

arms.label: magnitude-nodraft
arms.note: Magnitude with the drafter turned off. It isolates the kernel tuning from the speculative decoding.

arms.label: magnitude-gemma-e2b
arms.note: Magnitude, Gemma 4 E2B QAT Q4 from its catalog, default MTP drafter. This is the vendor's Magnitude arm for this model.

arms.label: ollama-gemma-e2b
arms.note: Ollama, Gemma 4 E2B QAT tag. Ollama has no MTP tag for E2B, so this arm runs without a drafter. Greedy, no penalties, thinking off.

arms.label: magnitude-qwen2b
arms.drafter: none (Magnitude offers no drafter for it)
arms.note: Magnitude, Qwen3.5 2B Q4_K_M from Hugging Face (unsloth). Magnitude offers no drafter for this model, so this is the pure engine.

arms.label: ollama-qwen2b
arms.note: Ollama, plain qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M tag, no drafter. The clean engine-against-engine match for magnitude-qwen2b.

arms.label: ollama-qwen2b-mtp
arms.note: Ollama, qwen3.5:2b-mtp-q4_K_M with its built-in MTP drafter. Shows what Ollama gets from its own drafter.

arms.label: magnitude-gemma-e4b
arms.note: Magnitude, Gemma 4 E4B QAT Q4 from its catalog with the MTP drafter. Magnitude rates it 'Snug (8 GB)': the model that fills this GPU.

arms.label: ollama-gemma-e4b
arms.note: Ollama, Gemma 4 E4B QAT tag (6.1 GB). Ollama has no MTP tag for E4B, so this arm runs without a drafter.
